purpose: test whether currently advertised zero-maker-and-taker-fee stablecoin triangles produce persistent direction-neutral executable surplus without forecasting BTC ETH or SOL direction

source_boundary.current_confirmation: later official Binance activity exclusions identify the selected pairs as zero-fee; every promotion remains revocable and account-region eligibility is unproved
source_boundary.fee_semantics: zero maker and taker fee for eligible users until further notice

capture.endpoint: GET https://api.binance.com/api/v3/ticker/bookTicker with all six symbols in one response
capture.one_shot_rule: do not alter universe thresholds sizes or sample ordering after book access
capture.raw_evidence: append and fsync one canonical JSON line per response before evaluation
capture.retry_policy: up to two retries per scheduled sample; any missing or invalid final sample rejects the screen

execution_model.quantity_rounding: floor each submitted base quantity to the symbol MARKET_LOT_SIZE step
execution_model.top_level_capacity: reject a size when any leg exceeds displayed top quantity
execution_model.cycle_ordering: evaluate both orientations from the same multi-symbol response

empirical_candidate_requires_for_one_cyc: every request elapsed at most 1500 milliseconds
at least 30 samples positive after 3 bips operational stress
at least one positive stressed sample in each of five sequential 120-sample blocks
positive stressed median among positive opportunities
displayed top-level capacity for the tested size in every counted opportunity
accepted_edge_requires_additionally: account confirmation that all three pair fees are zero at decision time
prospective paper fills proving three-leg completion and realized slippage
stablecoin depeg custody redemption and opportunity-cost limits
cross-window persistence beyond this five-minute diagnostic

prohibited_shortcuts: using last trades or nonsynchronous candles as fills
counting displayed quantity above the top level
ignoring partial completion stale-leg or stablecoin depeg risk
calling a five-minute public screen stable profitable or deployment-ready
